requirement: Build a scalable URL shortener service with APIs, persistence, and analytics.

risks.title: Code collision under high concurrency
risks.mitigation: Add DB unique constraint on (original, is_active=true) or use SELECT FOR UPDATE / advisory lock.
risks.tradeoff: Locking reduces throughput; constraint adds index overhead.

risks.title: Cache stampede on cold start
risks.mitigation: Implement probabilistic early expiration or request coalescing (single-flight pattern).
risks.tradeoff: Adds complexity; acceptable for MVP with low cold-start frequency.

risks.title: Analytics data loss on worker crash
risks.mitigation: Use a durable queue (Redis Streams / SQS) with at-least-once delivery for production.
risks.tradeoff: Adds operational complexity; asyncio tasks are sufficient for MVP.

risks.title: Open redirect abuse
risks.mitigation: Integrate URL reputation check (Google Safe Browsing API) before persisting. Add rate limiting per IP.
risks.tradeoff: External API call adds ~50ms latency to shorten path; acceptable trade-off.

risks.title: Short code exhaustion
risks.mitigation: Monitor code space utilization; increase length to 8 chars if needed.

risks.title: PostgreSQL single point of failure
risks.mitigation: AWS RDS Multi-AZ with automatic failover. Read replicas for analytics queries.
risks.tradeoff: Multi-AZ doubles DB cost; justified for production.
